verdict.rationale: AgentMail is API-first: agents register via API key (agentmail-docs-1), manage inboxes/messages/threads entirely through REST calls with an OpenAPI spec (agentmail-docs-2, agentmail-docs-3, agentmail-probe-2), and receive events via webhooks instead of polling, enabling fully headless event-driven automation (agentmail-docs-6). A CLI is documented for scriptable automation (agentmail-docs-13, agentmail-probe-4) and an MCP server exposes the same tools programmatically (agentmail-docs-12). missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions) and independent hands-on confirmation of headless/CI usage.
